verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and runtime, so controlling context or KV memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents context-size settings, memory budgets, or running multiple model instances at once. Hardware-acceleration claims (NPU, Metal) and download-progress details are adjacent features, not memory-allocation controls.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
